We need to produce a proper tool call. Let's construct.

<thought>We will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that matches the target molecule (the product of HWE) and has the functional groups formed: aliphatic carboxylic acid and C-C double bonds. We'll use the first SMILES from the precursors list as the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bonds"],
    "functional_groups_broken": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
Now we wait for result.
